lora_adapter: two adapters on the one base model: adapters/sql_rft_v3 (in the image: /code/models/lora, pass 1) and adapters/sql_v5 (/code/models/lora_v5, pass 2)
enable_thinking: hybrid: thinking for per-shop view and debt drafts (K=8, 6144 tok), for low-agreement questions (conf<0.75) and for every debt question on a shop with the debt layer (4 samples, 16384 tok); non-thinking for the 8 main SQL samples
temperature: 0.7 SQL samples; 0.6 / top_k 20 thinking; greedy repairs
note: Single inference model (Qwen3.5-9B) with two LoRA adapters of the same rank and modules (v3, v5), 9.74B params with both (<= 15B total). Two passes of the same pipeline, one adapter each, on the same per-shop layers; the samples of both passes vote once (pooled vote). fp8 online quant + fp8 KV cache. Run on 1x RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24GB outside Docker; RTX 5090 timing not validated yet.

training_only_models.use: data generation on train only, not in the image
